newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore liberalises live audiotex services.
newsitem.headline: Singapore liberalises live audiotex services.

text.p: The Telecommunication Authority of Singapore (TAS) said on Monday audiotex operators could now apply for licences to operate live services.
Live audiotex services enable a caller to receive chargeable information by dialing an 11-digit telephone number beginning with 1900.
The licence fee is Singapore $200 for every three years, TAS said.
Currently all audiotex programs are pre-recorded.
Live audiotex operators are required to publish call rates in all their advertisements and must ensure sufficient number of call-in lines, TAS said.
